---
name: fix-it-dont-file-it
scope: external
category: workflow
strength: require
provenance: 2026-08-05 · the owner's correction after a one-line default was filed as an issue instead of fixed during the session that found it
---

A finding you can fix in the session that found it gets fixed in that session. File only what does
not fit: a shape change, a decision that is not yours, a fix needing its own design.

Why: an issue is a promise to a future session that pays a full re-orientation to redo work already
loaded in the head that found it.

How to apply: bounded and obvious — a wrong default, a scope bug, a missing await — is fixed now,
with the test that proves it. When you do file, say why it did not fit.
